interface.shortDescription: Commercial credit origination and risk workflows
interface.longDescription:
Power commercial credit origination and portfolio management workflows with D&B Finance Analytics embedded AI decisioning layer.

Dun & Bradstreet connects the D&B Commercial Graph with proprietary customer data and credit policies to help evaluate applications, set credit limits, and uncover portfolio risk and opportunity.
